what is a filter bubble?

updated_at: 20 February, Tue, 16:27 posted_on: 20 February, Tue, 16:25

A filter bubble or ideological frame is a state of intellectual isolation[1] that can result from personalized searches, recommendation systems, and algorithmic curation.

Consequently, users become separated from information that disagrees with their viewpoints, effectively isolating them in their own cultural or ideological bubbles, resulting in a limited and customized view of the world.
